messages.subject: Error in extracting CN with CBS
parts:

wrong from the error message. Do you have any idea?

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Error in extracting CN with CBS
parts:
Hi,

yes that's a very tricky error, but I have my suspicion for what's
going on. It is probably that the file:

path <- "cbsData/TERATOMA,ACC,ra,-XY,BPN,-XY,AVG,A+B,FLN,-XY/GenomeWideSNP_6/";
filename <- "MZ15_368_testis
2A_(GenomeWideSNP_6),chr01,f767655de5770288729dde731f43c9fc.xdr";
pathname <- file.path(path, pathname);

is corrupt/incomplete. You might have run out of disk space or something.

If you do the above, what does this give you?

print(file.info(pathname));

/Henrik

messages.subject: Re: Error in extracting CN with CBS
parts:
Hi Henrik,

thanks, you were right. The file was incomplete. I removed it and re-
run and everything went smooth.
I run out of disk during execution and that was the problem

Regards

Marco
